name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd.

profile.summary: Bajaj Finserv Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides financial services in India. The company operates through Life Insurance, General Insurance, Windmill, Retail Financing, and Investments and Others segments. It offers personal, home, business, gold, loan for doctors and lawyers; loan against properties, securities, car, fixed deposit, insurance policy, mutual funds, and shares; unsecured and secured loans to small and medium-sized enterprises; two- and three-wheeler loans; used car and tractor loan; financing for products, such as consumer electronics, digital, furniture, e-commerce purchases and retail spends; developer financing; and lease rental discounting products.
